svg.title: Find a team and ask to join it — SoftTrack web design mockup (#259)
svg.desc: The only way onto a team is an invitation that a team admin thought to send. A team directory lists each team’s name, key, description, size and admins; asking to join notifies the admins, who approve with a role or decline; and a team can keep itself off the list or open itself to anyone.
